landmarks.what: SHA-keyed 20-run package timing history with median baseline and least-squares cap-trend projection
cap warning at 90% of go test's 600s wall, else trend warning from the SHA-excluded history; totals table gains median baseline and delta
guards the test job's actions/cache restore/save of the timing history: main-only first-attempt save, one runner.temp path, mutation-ts excluded

findings.text: The 'falling above the line' case (600 to 545) projects to about 407 at x=14, so the projection check alone already rejects it and it never reaches the slope > 0 check. Only the flat-at-545 case actually tests that slope check. The contract is still met.
loadHistory also returns the degraded note for a well-formed file with no entries, and for read errors other than not-found. Both are reported as one note line, not swallowed.
upsert stores the caller's totals map without copying it, so a caller that changes the map later would change the stored entry. Harmless with the current single use.

cmd/testsummary/main.go run(): with TESTSUMMARY_HISTORY set but GITHUB_SHA empty (e.g. a local run), totals are upserted under sha "" and that entry is the one left out of the baseline and trend; consider skipping the save, or noting it, when GITHUB_SHA is unset
TestRunHistoryUnset shows that no file appears in the working directory, but it cannot show that no read happened. That is fine: in the code the load and save are both inside histPath != "" checks
run() also upserts and saves on PR runs; per decision history_store, keeping PR results out of the stored history depends on the workflow saving the cache only on main, which this task does not cover

workflowSteps stores with:/env: mapping keys without unquoting them (internal/cmd/ci_go_test_step_test.go:102). The keyLines sweep in timingCacheProblems also matches only a bare `TESTSUMMARY_HISTORY:` prefix (internal/cmd/ci_timing_cache_test.go:487). So a quoted key such as `'TESTSUMMARY_HISTORY': ...` in mutation-ts's step or job env gets past both the step-env check and the job/workflow-env check. It is a rare spelling, but it is a gap in the 'only the test job carries the history' guard.

The mapping reader treats every deeper-indented line as a flat `key: value` pair and silently drops lines with no colon. A block scalar or nested map under with:/env: (for example github-script's `script: |`) would add made-up entries. None of the steps this guard reads use that shape, and keyLines counting raw lines (including inside run: blocks) can only cause false failures, not false passes.

I could not check offline that actions/cache/restore and actions/cache/save at 55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 really are the v6.1.0 tag. TestWorkflowActionsArePinned only checks that the ref and the comment have the right shape.
